skills.purpose: Lint memory ledgers (decisions.md, FACTS.md) for DRIFT, BROKEN, DANGLING, DUPLICATE. Use when writing a durable fact.
Search past Claude Code sessions by keyword (local BM25). Use for 'did we do X before' or context from earlier sessions.
Session snapshot, claim freezing and task state injected at SessionStart. Use /nvaex-memory:freeze to lock a claim.
Generate tiered MAP.md routers for a folder tree. Use when a directory is large or poorly navigable.
Archive repo residue (old plans, audits, duplicate docs, scratch), never delete. Use for repo bloat or folder cleanup.
Write or refresh the git branch's handoff note. Use when finishing work, before ending a session, or on /handoff.
Explain or review the daily episodic recap written at SessionEnd to NvAEx-Recaps/memory before promoting to MEMORY.md.
Maintain the six-file memory-bank/ folder. Use on 'initialize/update/read memory bank' or when a repo has memory-bank/.
Find recurring patterns in recent sessions; propose captures (rule, note, fix). Use on /patterns or 'keeps coming up'.
Log what was done and why in .whydone/. Use when asked to log the session or when the Stop nudge reports no entry today.
Park ideas and keep per-workstream notes in NvAEx-Recaps. Use on 'park this', 'add a workstream', 'what was open on X'.
